messages:
Maria (infra): quick heads-up — PR #4321 needs a short sec/privacy pass before we merge tonight. It scopes secrets from /shared/redwood/* -> /customers/rdw/* and tightens the SA. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321. Target merge window: 18:20 PT (avoid the 19:00 deploy).
Ajay: looking. quick Q — does this change the KMS key policy or add any kms:Decrypt ordering that could break rolling restarts? also any plan for existing secrets migration?
Kelsey: paste the SA diff here pls, i can do a quick glance. also add rollback steps in the PR description.
Maria (infra): diff snippet:
```diff
- roles/redwood:secret-reader
+ roles/redwood:limited-secret-read
```
Migration: we have a backfill script `scripts/migrate-secrets.sh --dry-run` that ran on staging already.
SecBot: secret-scan: token-like pattern found in `test/fixtures/test-fixture.yaml` — flagged but marked false positive by team. scan report: https://ci/reports/scan/9876 (reviewed).
Samir: @Maria (infra) does this require any new VPC egress rules? PR mentions calls to internal-kms via internal-api; want to ensure no cross-VPC egress is introduced.
Maria (infra): no new egress rules. calls internal-kms in the same VPC. verified with traceroute on staging and no external hops.
Olivia: FYI infra deploy at 19:00 — merging at 18:20 PT should be fine, avoid merging during the deploy. can you aim for 18:15-18:25?
Ajay: small ask: remove `secrets.list` from the SA if possible (we don't need listing). if you drop that i'll approve.
Maria (infra): updated PR: removed `secrets.list`. added rollback script `scripts/rollback-secret-path.sh`. CI is green except a flakey integration test unrelated to this change.
Kelsey: looks reasonable. pls add a one-line rationale in PR description (privacy/compliance reason) and then ping me, i'll approve.
Maria (infra): added: "scoping secrets per-customer to reduce blast radius and to comply with privacy policy C-1287."
SecBot: CI status: snyk scan passed; kms-policy-check: OK.
Samir: ran quick egress matrix across AZs — no cross-az/peered-vpc calls introduced. +1 from infra side.
Ajay: LGTM after Kelsey approves. i'll queue the merge at 18:20 PT.
Maria (infra): plan: canary rollout 10% traffic for 15m -> 50% -> 100%. i'll monitor logs/latency and rollback if anomalous. will ping here if we need ops stand-by.
Olivia: :thumbsup: will have ops on-call monitor at 18:20-19:00 if you ping.
Kelsey: approving now. please tag release notes and reference compliance ticket #C-1287 in the commit message.
Maria (infra): tagged release notes and added compliance ref. merging at 18:20 PT. thanks everyone.
SecBot: merge-bot: PR #4321 merged by Maria (infra) at 1768956125.
